scripts.dev: node scripts/env.js NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO=0 NEXT_PUBLIC_RELAY_PORT=3001 -- concurrently -n relay,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:relay" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:demo: node scripts/env.js NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO=1 -- pnpm run dev:web
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:webview && pnpm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir extension run lint && pnpm --dir extension run lint:test && pnpm --dir web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run test:root && pnpm --dir extension test
